metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Beijing, Chongqing, and Wuhan all decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 collection for tropospheric nitrogen dioxide - Two time periods: Jan 1-20, 2020 and Feb 10-25, 2020 - Three cities: Beijing, Chongqing, Wuhan (define Point geometries) 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P NO2 has a quality assurance band (qa_value) - Should filter for qa_value >= 0.5 for good quality data - The question is about NO2 levels, not clouds, so we should mask poor quality data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero or low NO2 values are possible (especially during COVID lockdown) - Need to check: * Collection size > 0 (C1 if fails) * Pixel count > 0 after masking (C2 if fails) * Mean value is not None/NaN (C3 if fails) - If all three cities show decrease (Jan > Feb), answer A - If any city does NOT decrease, answer B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define city geometries const beijing = ee.Geometry.Point([116.4074, 39.9042]); const chongqing = ee.Geometry.Point([106.5516, 29.5630]); const wuhan = ee.Geometry.Point([114.3055, 30.5928]); const cities = { 'Beijing': beijing, 'Chongqing': chongqing, 'Wuhan': wuhan }; // 2. Define time periods const period1_start = '2020-01-01'; const period1_end = '2020-01-21'; const period2_start = '2020-02-10'; const period2_end = '2020-02-26'; // 3. Load Sentinel-5P NO2 collection const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const results = {}; // 4. Process each city for (const [cityName, cityGeom] of Object.entries(cities)) { // Period 1 (January) const col1 = collection.filterDate(period1_start, period1_end) .filterBounds(cityGeom); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0) { console.log(`${cityName} Period1: No images found`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Period 2 (February) const col2 = collection.filterDate(period2_start, period2_end) .filterBounds(cityGeom); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (size2 === 0) { console.log(`${cityName} Period2: No images found`); console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean for period 1 const mean1_img = col1.mean(); const stats1 = mean1_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: cityGeom.buffer(10000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Calculate mean for period 2 const mean2_img = col2.mean(); const stats2 = mean2_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: cityGeom.buffer(10000), scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean2 = stats2.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); // Check for invalid results if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || isNaN(mean1)) { console.log(`${cityName}: Invalid Period1 result`); console.log("C3"); return; } if (mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log(`${cityName}: Invalid Period2 result`); console.log("C3"); return; } const decreased = mean2 < mean1; results[cityName] = { jan: mean1, feb: mean2, decreased: decreased, images1: size1, images2: size2 }; console.log(`${cityName}: Jan=${mean1.toExponential(3)} (n=${size1}), Feb=${mean2.toExponential(3)} (n=${size2}), Decreased=${decreased}`); } // 5. Check if all cities decreased const allDecreased = Object.values(results).every(r => r.decreased); if (allDecreased) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
